create_graph_from_nodes_edges: create a Graph instance from a list of node strings and edge tuples with source, target, and edge attributes
build_graph_from_edges_list: build a Graph instance from a list of tab-separated edge strings using the from_edges class method
subsample_graph_nodes: subsample the nodes of a Graph by a given rate while optionally preserving a specified center node
load_raw_dataset: load a RawDataset to iterate over untokenized graph-text pairs from a gzipped file with optional shuffling
create_graph2text_dataset: create a Graph2TextDataset that processes graph-text pairs into batched jraph GraphsTuple tensors for model training
